import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('products/services/nlnet-csv-milestone')
acceptance_path = root / 'station-csv-acceptance.json'
baseline_path = root / 'suite-evidence.json'
acceptance = json.loads(acceptance_path.read_bytes())
baseline = json.loads(baseline_path.read_bytes())
expected = {'clean': [], 'missing_required_column': [{'kind': 'missing_required_column', 'header': 'reading'}], 'extra_field': [{'kind': 'column_count', 'record': 2, 'expected': 2, 'actual': 3}]}
cases = acceptance['cases']
assert acceptance['all_pass'] is True
for name, issues in expected.items():
    assert cases[name]['passed'] is True and cases[name]['issues'] == issues, name
assert baseline['exit_code'] == 0 and 'passed 10/10' in baseline['stdout']
brief = {
    'public_benefit': 'Help maintainers catch structural errors in public station CSV exports before publishing changed files.',
    'proposed_deliverables': ['Document a local check that requires the reading column.', 'Provide three fictional fixtures and a repeatable acceptance command.', 'Document what structural validation covers and which measurement semantics require separate checks.'],
    'milestone_acceptance': expected,
    'observed_controls': {name: cases[name] for name in expected},
    'observed_regression_result': baseline['stdout'].strip(),
    'evidence_sha256': {str(path): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in (acceptance_path, baseline_path)},
    'limits': 'The results cover fictional inputs. Applicant eligibility, submission, award and payment require separate evidence.'
}
output = root / 'technical-milestone-brief.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(brief, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
assert json.loads(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == brief
print(output)
print(json.dumps(brief, indent=2))
